name: @deepseaxx/koishi-plugin-message-capsule
description: Package a replied message or merged record into TXT, JSON, HTML, PNG, group files, or a text-only forward.

scripts.prepublishOnly: tsc -p tsconfig.check.json && tsx --test tests/*.test.ts && tsc -p tsconfig.json && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node18 --format=cjs --external:koishi --outfile=lib/index.js

description.en: Package replied messages or merged records. Full merged-record reading currently requires a OneBot adapter with getForwardMsg; other adapters work when they provide standard expanded forward elements.
description.zh: 把被回复的消息或合并记录封装为文件或文字转发。完整读取合并记录目前需要提供 getForwardMsg 的 OneBot 适配器；其他适配器需提供标准展开节点。
